Advanced SQL including triggers and stored procedures
Introduction to transactions and database reliability

paragraphs: Design relational databases based on given requirements

Document database systems and programming assignments

paragraphs: Week 1–3: SQL fundamentals and advanced queries
Week 4–6: Relational model, ER modeling, and design
Week 7–8: Relational algebra and midterm exam
Week 13–14: NoSQL systems and project discussions
